title: feat(id/serve-proxy): wire CreditWindow into mux DATA-accept and credit-return paths

labels.name: app/id
labels.description: Package/app: id (pkgs/ or apps/ in this repo)

body:
Follow-on to #8970 (criterion 3 — mux-level accounting), filed per the 2026-11-23 done-checks on #8970.

## State

Criteria 1, 2, and 4 of #8970 are landed on main by PR #10977 (merged 2026-11-17): `CreditWindow` in `pkgs/id/src/serve_proxy.rs` carries a construction-time `ceiling`, `grant()` returns an explicit error on over-ceiling/overflow with no state change, and ceiling unit tests plus the `credit_is_never_exceeded` proptest cover it.

Criterion 3 remains open because there is no mux consumer yet: on current main `CreditWindow` is referenced only inside `serve_proxy.rs`, and the only "mux" mentions are doc comments assigning the remaining work to the future mux slice. There is no DATA path to attach accounting to, so #8970 cannot be closed from inside the primitive alone.

## Work

Build the mux consumer of the serve-proxy credit primitive (design record #5792), then wire the accounting:

1. Per-stream and aggregate per-connection `CreditWindow`s in the mux DATA-accept path: `try_consume` before queueing DATA; refuse (do not go negative) when the send would exceed granted credit.
2. Credit-return path: `grant()` on received `WINDOW_UPDATE`, bounded by each window's ceiling.
3. Map `grant()` errors to an ERROR frame with `ErrorReason::CreditOverrun` (the primitive already defines the reason; the mux slice builds the frame).

## Acceptance

- DATA accepted only within granted per-stream credit and aggregate per-connection credit.
- A `WINDOW_UPDATE` that would push a window past its ceiling (or overflow) is rejected with an `ErrorReason::CreditOverrun` ERROR frame and leaves the window unchanged.
- Credit returns only as bounded buffer space is released (no silent saturation anywhere in the path).
- Tests: unit + property coverage for per-stream and aggregate accounting, over-ceiling/repeated `WINDOW_UPDATE`, and unchanged state after refusal.

## Constraints

- Do not invent a universal deployment limit: ceilings stay parameterized from the effective configuration, as #8970 requires (`CreditWindow::new(initial, ceiling)`; built-in `per_stream()` / `per_connection()` are fixed-size at their configured initial credit).
- Closing this issue closes #8970 (its last open criterion).

## Labels / routing

`app/id`, `kind/feature`. Effort is above xs — this is a build issue, not a triage item.
